newsitem.title: GERMANY: Eurowings orders five ATR42-500 aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Eurowings orders five ATR42-500 aircraft.

text.p: FRANKFURT, June 16 Reuter) - German regional carrier Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG said it has ordered five ATR42-500 turboprop aircraft from European manufacturer Aero International Regional (AIR).
The contract, signed Monday at the Le Bourget air show, includes options for five further aircraft, a statement said.

Aerospatiale and Finmeccanica's Alenia unit build the ATR for AIR. No value for the order was given. The aircraft will be delivered from October 1997 to January 1998 and will replace older turboprops in the Eurowings fleet, the statement said.
Eurowings operates a fleet of 17 ATR 42, six ATR72-200 and four ATR 72-210 turboprops as well as six BAe 146 jets and two Airbus A319 aircraft.
